narrative_summary: A sensible GPU deployment escalates into routing Qwen through 5,600 Lambdas before paying 80 times Gemini's price to avoid GPUs.
rationale: Candidate 4 turns the story's real technical details into a clean, escalating sequence and lands an earned final irony: paying $8.40 per million tokens to save on GPUs. Candidate 2 has a fresher phrase, but its H2O-Lightning/Qwen switch and overloaded final panel weaken the construction.
story_title: Serving Qwen via AWS Lambdas for fun and 80x negative profit
